title: Data
sub: Reading and writing ICONICS points through the bridge backend
deleteNote: Note: after deleting, the .@@Count total may take a while to refresh (ICONICS caches it); use the reload button if the table does not add up straight away.
addNote: Note: after adding, the .@@Count point may take a while to refresh (ICONICS caches it) and the new row appears in its sorted position, not at the end of the table.
